libs.name: 天下 Beta
libs.english_description: Self-titled "Tianxia (World Under Heaven) Beta," credited to an author known as "Discovery No. (Find@tx)" — from the same author as this archive's "Nitan" series, though built on a completely independent codebase.

libs.name: 天下无雪
libs.english_description: Self-titled "A World Without Snow," credited to an author known as "Dream" with an acknowledgments list naming several fellow wizards (Poor, Sinb, Lonely, Zjb, among others) — a long-running Chinese wuxia MUD with its own distinct setting. Its map, however, turns out to share deep roots with this archive's "Tianya" (Horizon) lineage: several scenes, including its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump location, are byte-for-byte identical to areas in other differently-branded games in that lineage — a connection no prior entry in this archive had documented before. One of its credited wizards, "Lonely," is also the author of the Nitan series, hinting at genuine code and personnel exchange across this wider MUD community.

libs.name: 狂想空间
libs.english_description: Both the game configuration and the in-game banner call it "Rhapsody Realm" — the archive filename's "New Rhapsody Realm II" is a title the collecting site added, not the game's real name. It's a venerable mudlib engine dating to 1995 ("ES II" / Eastern Stories II architecture), released in 2002 by Taiwanese wizard wade, and belongs to the same large ES II family as this project's es1_win, esI, xkx2001, and Liaoning Hotline Station archives, among others.

libs.name: 狂想空间
libs.english_description: A venerable Taiwanese MUD founded September 22, 1995 (by wade, shorst, jcder, and others), part of the ES II engine series shared with this project's es1_win, esI, xkx2001, rzrmud, and the Ode to Gallantry series. This project also holds another archive that likewise calls itself "Rhapsody Realm" (with added features like email registration) — comparison shows the two are independently circulated versions from different eras, and this is the earlier of the two snapshots.

libs.name: 月影奇缘
libs.english_description: The login banner also reads "Century Journey to the West: Moon Love Story" — a venerable MUD adapted from the Journey to the West mythos. It belongs to the ES II engine series (sharing lineage with this project's es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, and xo, with the master file's authorship traceable back through developer "Lil" to "Annihilator").

libs.name: 未明空间 (Weiming Kongjian / "wmkj")
libs.english_description: The archive is labeled "Weiming Kongjian," but once connected the game actually identifies itself as "Jianghu Fengyun: Sunset Reappears" — a branch of the "Sunset Reappears" (Xi Yang Zai Xian) engine family that shares lineage with this collection's xyzxfk and jhfy, though each was developed independently rather than being a simple reskin. It belongs to the true "Sunset Reappears" bloodline alongside this collection's xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412 — notably distinct from another group of archives here that carry the same brand name but actually descend from an unrelated "Tianya" codebase, a reminder that branding alone doesn't indicate lineage.

libs.name: 大话西游 (A Chinese Odyssey)
libs.english_name: A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You)
libs.english_description: The original archive was labeled "Wuhan Station," but that's just a collector's site tag — the game's own config and login banner identify its true name as A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You), themed after the beloved Stephen Chow film, and run by the Xiangfan branch of Hubei's Chutian Hotline network. It belongs to the ES II (Eastern Stories II) engine family, sharing lineage with this collection's wmkj and tiexuejianghu, though each was developed independently.

libs.name: 泥潭III测试版 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan_ceshi)
libs.english_description: An early internal test snapshot from the NT/nitan/Lonely engine lineage (shared with sibling games nitan170911, nitan6, and nitan_san in this collection), internally labeled 'Mire 3' but branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm' — a thematic skin layered over the nitan engine. New characters choose a name and personality, reroll their stats, and are then delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life, following the setting's creation-myth cosmology. Unlike its relative nitan170911, this branch needs no external MySQL database — everything runs on local files, so the full registration-to-gameplay flow works out of the box.

libs.name: 泥潭三 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan_san)
libs.english_description: The true 'third generation' release of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine lineage — its login banner literally reads 'once you enter the Mire, it runs as deep as the sea.' Like its close relative nitan_ceshi, it's branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm,' a skin over the shared nitan engine. Character creation follows the same creation-myth path: choose a name and personality, reroll stats, and be delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life. It shares its sibling's independence from any external database, though the two branches evolved separately and each carries its own small quirks.

libs.name: 浴血重生
libs.english_description: The login banner identifies itself as "1.YXCS" / "Reborn in Blood." Its lineage is unusual: it carries traces of the ES II engine series (files like chinesed.lpc trace authorship back through the "ES"-to-"XKX" branch) mixed with modules later rewritten by "Lonely," the author behind the Nitan/NT series — making it a deeply modified hybrid rather than a pure descendant of any single lineage. Its map can be pinned down more precisely: the "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is byte-identical to the unrelated "Tianya" family shared by several other archives in this collection.

libs.archive: 海洋II 2010 正式无错完整版下载 (1).rar
libs.name: 海洋II 2010 正式无错完整版下载
libs.english_description: The game calls itself Ocean II, though its more commonly used in-game name is Star and Moon Legend. It belongs to the classic “ES II” engine family (shared lineage with es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, xo, Wuhan Station, and Legend of the Yellow Emperor's Soul in this project) and was one of the more widely circulated Chinese wuxia MUDs of its era. hymud (Ocean V: Star and Moon Legend) is its independent successor.

libs.name: 海洋V·星月传奇
libs.english_name: Ocean V: Star and Moon Legend
libs.english_description: The game calls itself Ocean V, with the in-game banner name Star and Moon Legend (displayed as 〈Ocean V — Star and Moon Legend〉 on login). It's a successor within the classic “ES II” engine family's Ocean II branch — an independent evolution of haiyang2 (Ocean II) in this project — and is the largest archive processed in this project to date, with roughly 57,000 source files in its working directory.

libs.name: Naruto
libs.english_description: The game calls itself Huoying (Naruto); its underlying engine identifies itself in comments as “Neolith 0.0.2,” and it belongs to the “ES2” engine family (shared lineage with Wuhan Station and Xueying Qiyuan in this project). Themed after the Japanese anime Naruto, players take on the role of a ninja, and the login screen features a fairly elaborate ANSI color ASCII-art logo.

libs.name: 「武林群侠传」之炎黄武魂Ⅱ
libs.english_name: Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang II
libs.english_description: Part of the ES II engine family (the 2003 "Yan-Huang" branch), and a close sibling to this collection's "Chronicle of Yan-Huang Heroes" — both trace back to the same 2003 engine rewrite by developer "lxtx."

libs.name: 炎黄英雄史（游戏内也称"皇朝再现"）
libs.english_description: Part of the ES II engine family (the 2003 "Yan-Huang" branch), and a close sibling to "Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang II" — the two share the same underlying engine but each has its own independent storyline and world details.

libs.name: 玄剑录
libs.english_description: Part of the ES II / Xiake Xing ("Wandering Blade") engine family, sharing lineage with titles such as "Xiake Xing 2001," but with its own independent wuxia world and storyline centered on sects and locations including the Ming Cult, Kunlun, and Xiake Island. Its files carry a "Cracked by Kafei" header, placing it in the same release batch as xkx2000zxb (a separate archive, xkx2001, circulated under a different "Cracked by Roath" release).

libs.name: 碧血残阳 之「豪侠晚歌」
libs.english_name: Jade Blood, Fading Sun: Ballad of the Twilight Knight
libs.english_description: Part of the "Sunset Reborn" engine family shared with several sibling archives in this project, built, per the author, atop "Sunset Reborn – Jianghu Storm 2 – Storm Resurgent." New characters are placed at random into one of several starting towns across a jianghu spanning Jiaxing, Yangzhou, and other locales, with gender-specific scene descriptions and a full underworld resurrection subsystem shared with sibling games in the same engine family.

libs.name: 神州
libs.english_description: A veteran Chinese wuxia mudlib self-styled 'Divine Land,' run by the Shenzhou Development Guild and built on the ES II engine family shared with sibling games Suiyuan Sword Legend and Heaven Without Snow in this collection, maintained across several generations of developers. New characters start out at the 'Hall of Novices' to get their bearings before formally entering the jianghu, with long-term systems for offline training, guilds, and a dedicated blacksmith profession rounding out a classic stats/sects/martial-cultivation core.

libs.name: 神魔（西游记之神魔传说）
libs.english_name: Gods and Demons: Legend of the Journey West (shenmo)
libs.english_description: A long-lived ES II/Neolith-engine game — sharing its engine lineage with sibling games shenzhou and Suiyuan Sword Legend in this collection — developed and maintained continuously from 1994 to 2013 by a long succession of wizards, and one of the largest archives in this collection at over 30,000 source files. Characters choose to be human, immortal, or demon before setting out from the South City Inn in Chang'an on a Journey-to-the-West-themed adventure through the demons and deities encountered along Tang Sanzang's pilgrimage route, built on the classic wuxia/xianxia progression of stats, sects, and martial cultivation. The South Sea Guanyin's Mount Putuo order even carries a persistent 'head disciple' title that naturally passes between characters as the game is played over time.

libs.archive: 笑傲江湖服务端+客户端.rar
libs.name: 笑傲江湖之重出江湖
libs.english_name: Xiao Ao Jiang Hu: Return to the Jianghu
libs.english_description: By author AKAI, this game grew out of the "Sunset Reappears — Jianghu Fengyun 2 — Storm Rising Again" engine lineage, a branch of the broader Sunset Reappears/XYZX family shared with other archives in this collection, though its content was developed independently. The archive name's "server + client" actually refers to support for two connection protocols on the same game — plain telnet and a TOMUD menu client — not a bundled standalone client program.

libs.name: 紫藤站
libs.english_name: Great Tang Journey West: Purple Wisteria Station
libs.english_description: Great Tang Journey West — Purple Wisteria Station (its in-game banner reads 'Purple Wisteria Journey West'), part of the ES II engine family, sharing common ancestry with this collection's es1_win/xkx2001/rzrmud and likewise signed 'for ES II mudlib, original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator' in its master file.

libs.name: 终极地狱之轩辕传说
libs.english_description: Internally identified as hell.local, part of the ES II engine family alongside es1_win/xkx2001/rzrmud in this collection, its master file's authorship trail running through 'for ES II mudlib' to 'Annihilator', 'Xiang for XKX', and 'Doing Lu for hell'. Two other archives in this collection also happen to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in their name (zjdyaryl and zjdyzj) — those belong to a separate branch of the 'Hell' lineage and are different games entirely, sharing only the coincidental title; all three have unrelated content.

libs.archive: 终极地狱之爱若幽兰1.166正式版.rar
libs.name: 终极地狱之爱若幽兰
libs.english_name: Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan
libs.english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'Hell's Quagmire — Ai Ruo You Lan' (the archive's own title is 'Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan'). Part of the ES II to XKX to 'Hell' branch of the engine family, and a sister build of this collection's zjdyzj ('Fingertip MUD' edition), sharing the same 'Hell' engine core down to an identical master file. Not the same game as zhongjidiyu, another archive in this collection that also happens to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in its name.

libs.archive: 终极地狱-指间mud版服务端.rar
libs.name: 终极地狱-指间MUD版
libs.english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'No Escape From Hell' (the archive's own title is 'Ultimate Hell — Fingertip MUD Edition'). Part of the ES II to XKX to 'Hell' branch of the engine family, and a sister build of this collection's zjdyaryl ('Ai Ruo You Lan'), sharing the same 'Hell' engine core with an added layer supporting the 'Fingertip MUD' mobile-client protocol. Not the same game as zhongjidiyu, another archive in this collection that also happens to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in its name.

libs.name: 西行战记
libs.english_description: A jianghu MUD set against the backdrop of Journey to the West, where new players start at the "South City Inn" in Chang'an and progress through scripture-seeking, demon-slaying, and sect trials. Part of an independent branch of the ES II (Eastern Stories II) architecture, distantly related to several other Journey to the West / ES II MUDs in this collection, it retains classic ES II staples such as message boards, talent-point allocation, and the four core attributes (physique, bone-root, comprehension, spirit), well suited to players who enjoy slow-paced text character progression.

libs.name: 重生的世界 (Revival World)
libs.english_description: RWlib v1.0.1, a life-simulation and city-management MUD developed by a Taiwanese team — an entirely independent, self-built engine unrelated to this collection's wuxia-themed mudlibs. Rather than combat and leveling, it centers on farming, fishing, animal husbandry, running factories, real-estate trading, stock speculation, and mahjong, backed by a full system of city mayors, taxation, and enterprises; new characters can settle in a city (currently just one, the 'Abandoned City') to build a livelihood there.

libs.name: 铁血江湖 (Tie Xue Jiang Hu)
libs.english_name: Tie Xue Jiang Hu (Blood and Iron Jianghu)
libs.english_description: A wuxia mudlib built on the ES II (Eastern Stories II) engine, part of the same family as this archive's Wuhanzhan (A Chinese Odyssey) and Weiming Kongjian, though it is an independently developed branch. Created by the author "hxsd," it centers on sect management and NPC recruitment, backed by an unusually complete merchant/trading subsystem the author likened to Uncharted Waters. New players start at the Hero's Tavern and can train in martial arts, roam the jianghu, and join a sect to earn income from its holdings. The original server closed after its popularity waned and its wizard staff fell into internal conflict, after which the author released the source code — this archive preserves that release.

libs.name: 随缘洗剑录
libs.english_name: Sui Yuan Xi Jian Lu (Sword Washed by Fate)
libs.english_description: Self-titled "Sui Yuan Xi Jian Lu" (roughly, "the chronicle of washing one's sword as fate wills"), a member of the ES II engine family — kin to this archive's Shenzhou, Huoying, and Wuhan-station titles — repeatedly rewritten from the original ES II base by Annihilator and others. It's a long-running, well-established wuxia MUD.

libs.name: 魔幻世纪 (mohuanshiji)
libs.english_description: A Qingdao-hosted branch of the 'Mythic Journey West' (SJXY) family, built on the ES II engine as an independent take on the Journey to the West mythos — sharing the same setting as sibling games mhxy and rzrmud in this collection but with its own separate codebase. New characters set out from the South City Inn, greeted by classic figures like Tang Sanzang and the inn's waiter as NPCs; the game layers in original sects such as Wudang and Yihua Palace not found in the source novel, making it one of the more content-rich entries in this sub-genre.

libs.name: 三界传说
libs.english_description: A jianghu world set against the backdrop of the classical Chinese cosmology of the "Three Realms" — Heaven, the Mortal World, and the Underworld. It shares only a name with the similarly titled sanjieshenhua elsewhere in this archive; file-by-file comparison of their master.lpc, securityd.lpc, and logind.lpc confirms the two are unrelated codebases.

libs.name: 三界神话「嘉峪关」
libs.english_description: A mythology-themed mudlib set across the 'Three Realms' cosmology, distinct in its underlying codebase from the similarly-named sjcs (Legend of the Three Realms) despite the overlapping title. New characters set out from the South City Inn and choose from six unusually fantasy-flavored classes — swordsman, mage, terminator, elf, barbarian, or dark hell emissary — a broader genre mashup than the typical wuxia sect system. Registration sets up both an everyday login password and a separate recovery password, and the game has its own built-in anti-flood measures: a 60-second logout cooldown for regular accounts and rate-limiting on rapid reconnects.

libs.name: 最终幻境
libs.english_description: The Final Frontier (FF), a space-opera science-fiction MUD adapted from the 'Dongfang Gushi II' (Eastern Story II, ES2) codebase, founded by Spock — a rare sci-fi reskin within this collection's ES II/Eastern Story family, rather than the usual wuxia setting. Its save data was originally Traditional Chinese (BIG5) and has been converted to UTF-8.

libs.name: 最新鳥人世界
libs.english_description: A Traditional Chinese wuxia MUD drawing its plots and riddles from Jin Yong's fifteen novels. Players start out at the Dragon Gate Inn and make their way through sects and cities across the jianghu, training internal power, external martial arts, and other skills along the way — a classic wuxia framework of stats, sects, master-disciple bonds, guilds, and rankings. Deep testing traced its lineage back to cctx (Chi Cheng Tian Xia), an independent branch descended from the same original codebase.

libs.name: 翱翔天际
libs.english_description: A Chinese wuxia/xianxia MUD descended from a classic Journey to the West codebase; its login banner styles it "Soaring Through the Heavens: Grasping the Sun and Drawing the Moon." Players start at the South City Inn, develop five innate attributes, and choose one of four temperaments, then progress through storyline chapters echoing Journey to the West ("Havoc in Heaven," "The Journey for Scriptures") alongside a full sect and alliance system built for long-term character growth.

libs.name: 银河英雄传说
libs.english_description: Sourced from a bulk mudlib archive collected on 2026-07-29. A branch of the ES II engine family (its master.c credits "original by Lil, rewritten by Annihilator"), redesigned around the setting of Yoshiki Tanaka's science-fiction novel and anime series Legend of the Galactic Heroes.

libs.name: 鹿鼎天下 (in-game: 雄霸天下『西安站』)
libs.english_description: From the "Deer and Cauldron World.rar" archive within a 2026-07-29 bulk mudlib collection. Part of the "Century (Shiji) / adm-single" engine family (sharing lineage with this project's shiji, shujian2008, xjcq2000, xkxz2, and xiakexing100), itself descended from ES II. Curiously, the archive itself is named "Deer and Cauldron World," but the login banner actually brands the game "Xiongba Tianxia (Hero's Dominion), Xi'an Station," while the quit message says "you have left Deer and Cauldron World" — both names linger in the code, suggesting an incomplete rebrand at some point in its history.

libs.name: 红尘 (in-game: 红尘录)
libs.english_description: Sourced from a 红尘.rar (hongchen.rar) archive within a 2026-07-29 batch upload; its full in-game title is “Chronicle of the Red Dust” (红尘录). It is an independent work within the ES II engine family.

libs.name: 驰骋天下
libs.english_description: A traditional ES2/XKX-lineage wuxia MUD featuring the familiar sects (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, Beggars' Sect, Emei, Ming Cult) alongside a distinctive northwestern frontier region around Jiayuguan, complete with desert scenes, a city gate, and a pawnshop — an unusually large excursion into frontier themes for this family of games. Newcomers are actively guided by an NPC greeter just outside the welcome room who offers basic survival commands and travel funds.

libs.name: 东方故事IIv1.3b
libs.english_description: An early build (1994-2000) of the ES II engine created by Taiwanese developer Annihilator, in Traditional Chinese, whose login banner also styles itself "Celestial Empire." Its only map content is a single snow village — plaza, inn, blacksmith, market, ruins — closer to the engine's own bundled demo village than a fully realized sect-and-jianghu game, making it the likely origin point for the "original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator" lineage seen in later archives in this project.

libs.name: 大唐西游完整修正版
libs.english_name: Great Tang Journey to the West (Complete Revised Edition)
libs.english_description: A Journey to the West-lineage MUD sharing the classic ES II GB/BIG5 encoding-switch mechanism with several sibling archives in this project. Set in the mythological world of Journey to the West — the Thirty-Three Heavens, the Peach Garden, Penglai, the Heavenly Palace — it uniquely asks new players at registration whether they are a primary or secondary school student, and separates ordinary login passwords from a stricter admin password reserved for sensitive account operations.

libs.name: 非凡夕阳MUD
libs.english_description: Part of the "Roaming Swordsman" engine lineage, though its own login banner instead reads "Extraordinary Young Master: Legend of the New Moon II." Despite the differing names, its map and key scenes are byte-identical to several sibling archives in this project, confirming it belongs to a shared family built on Jin Yong's sect and map world (Huashan, Wudang, Emei, Beggars' Sect, Ming Cult, Tianlong Temple, and more). Uniquely requires clients to send an exact version-handshake string before login proceeds, and needed no mudlib code changes at all to run under WASM.

libs.name: 风云三
libs.english_description: The archive is named “Storm III,” but the actual login banner reads “Jianghu of Blood and Iron” — the content has nothing to do with the archive's filename; it's simply a naming mismatch.

libs.name: 风云四解密版
libs.english_description: A “Storm IV” MUD (Sumxin Storm) set in the world of Gu Long's novels. It shares the same codebase as this collection's xsfyssjb (“Heart's Voice Storm IV Upgraded Edition”) — the d/dreamland/ area and other scene files are byte-for-byte identical — though neither archive had previously documented this relationship.

libs.name: 风云之风起云涌
libs.english_description: A “Storm” MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels.

libs.name: 国家制度的MUD DA
libs.english_description: An ES2-lineage MUD (the author credits Annihilator/ES2 in the login banner). Its in-game title is “Gourd II / Demon Angel” — a simplified Chinese-language adaptation.

libs.name: hell
libs.english_description: The in-game title is “Revive of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic) from 1999.11.13” (the author calls themselves “doing”). It's a large Jin Yong-themed mudlib in the “Doing” lineage, comprising more than 7,000 LPC files.

libs.name: 幻想西天加强版
libs.english_description: The in-game title is “Chronicle of the Journey West” (MudOS v22pre11 MudLib Build 3310) — a traditional GB/BIG5 dual-encoding ES-lineage mudlib themed after Journey to the West.

libs.name: 海洋2000
libs.english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II — an ES2/Jin Yong-themed mudlib. It belongs to the “Ocean/hy” code family alongside fqyy2 (Storm Rising 2) in this project — both point their SECURITY_D to adm/daemons/securd.lpc.

libs.name: 海洋2002
libs.english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II, and it's a follow-on, evolved version of hy2000 in this project — the two share 10,630 of 10,632 files by path, with hy2002 adding roughly 3,000 new files on top (new maps, new sect content, and more).

libs.name: 火云
libs.english_description: The in-game title is Fire Cloud Chronicle 2000 (火云录2000) — an ES/Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Despite sharing the “hy” prefix with hy, hy2000, and hy2002 (the “Ocean”-titled family) in this project, file-by-file comparison of the core master.lpc, securd.lpc, and securityd.lpc confirms it is not the same lineage — the two families merely happen to both be ES2-derived, Jin Yong-themed wuxia MUDs. hy3's master.lpc has an entirely different structure (credited to “change by xhh,” 363 lines, versus the three byte-identical 332-line “for ES II mudlib” versions in the hy family), and its wizard directories under u/ (xingyun, xingyu, hsly) point to an independently maintained codebase.

libs.archive: 海洋II上海站第三次版本.rar
libs.name: 海洋II上海站第三次版本
libs.english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II, and it's a sibling version to hy2000 and hy2002 in this project (sharing roughly 9,600 and 10,253 files by path with each, respectively) — a snapshot of the third version deployed on the Shanghai server, from the same ES2/Jin Yong-themed codebase.

libs.name: 江湖2006
libs.english_description: The in-game title is Jianghu 2005 (Annihilator/Book-and-Sword ES2 lineage), a Jin Yong-themed mudlib.

libs.name: 江湖风云2
libs.english_name: Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II
libs.english_description: In-game titled "Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II: Liaoning Storm Rising," a Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Its map directory structure nearly matches this project's "Tianya" (Ends of the Earth) family (tybxjh, xhcii, zxty, ffxymud), and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is identical in content (a formatting tool added stray spaces to this copy, but the core text matches word for word) — making it the sixth confirmed member of that family, a relationship no archive had previously recorded.

libs.name: 江湖风云3
libs.english_description: In-game titled "Sunset Reappears: Storm Rising II," a sequel/expansion of this project's jhfy2 (7,977 of jhfy2's 9,332 files overlap by path, with jhfy3 substantially expanding on that base), a Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Despite the heavy file-path overlap with jhfy2, this archive's "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is actually byte-identical not to jhfy2's "Tianya" family version but to xajh4gkb (Xiao'ao Jianghu 4, Public Edition, which also carries the "Sunset Reappears" brand) and xyzx (one of the original "Sunset Reappears" releases) — showing that "Sunset Reappears" is a separate code lineage from "Tianya," and that this archive builds on jhfy2's map while swapping in "Sunset Reappears" core system files.

libs.name: 金庸群侠传
libs.english_description: In-game titled "The Story of Hero," a Jin Yong-themed mudlib that shares a common master.lpc with this project's jyqxc2, jyqxc2013fwq, fy2mg, and xkx2017 (the "Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes"/XKX framework family), with a relatively compact map spanning sects like Mount Hua, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, and the Ming Cult.

libs.name: 金庸群侠传
libs.english_description: A sibling archive to this project's jyqxc (numbers 086/087). A file-by-file diff confirmed the two are, in essence, two near-complete snapshots of the same original data rather than independently developed variants sharing only the same architecture — of roughly 3,690 files in each "work" tree, only a handful differ (a not-yet-patched login script, two runtime logs, and each one's leftover test character), while the death system and other core files are byte-for-byte identical. The archive filenames even show the classic browser double-download pattern, suggesting both came from the same original download that this project's deduplication process didn't catch.

libs.name: 金庸群侠传2013_服务器版
libs.english_name: The Story of Hero (2013 Server Edition)
libs.english_description: Another archive in the same architecture family as this project's jyqxc and jyqxc2 (a 2013 server-side release) — most of its file content differs, but the overall structure and known bug surface are essentially the same. Unlike jyqxc2's relationship to jyqxc, a file-by-file diff confirmed this is a genuinely independent snapshot rather than a byte-identical duplicate, with its own unique bugs including a stray angle-bracket #include path that once crashed every score command.

libs.name: 狂想空间II
libs.english_description: A mudlib derived from the ES II/Annihilator architecture line, a different lineage from the jyqxc family (it uses the driver's native plaintext save format rather than that family's old binary format). A diff against this project's kxkj (#036, "Rhapsody Realm") shows byte-identical master.lpc, securityd.lpc, and death-system files — not an adaptation or sequel, but another independent snapshot of the same 2002 release by Taiwanese wizard wade, differing by only about 10 runtime files. Each archive independently built its own newbie zone under the shared name "Snow Village," with different actual content — evidence of two separately built instances of the same engine source rather than one being derived from the other.

libs.name: 鹿鼎天下II
libs.english_description: A sibling release to this project's ldtx, sharing the same Century/adm-single architecture family but with mostly independent content rather than file-level duplication. Despite a login banner and BBS links inherited from an unrelated "Xiongba Tianxia" engine template, a codebase search confirms the actual game content is genuinely themed around Jin Yong's novel The Deer and the Cauldron, with 48 files referencing characters and factions like Wei Xiaobao, the Divine Dragon Cult, and Emperor Kangxi.

libs.name: 模拟华附
libs.english_description: A campus-life simulation mudlib set at the real-world campus of South China Normal University's Affiliated High School (Huafu) in Guangzhou. Unlike other campus-themed games in this collection, it has no wuxia or fantasy trappings — its map faithfully recreates real school locations like classroom buildings, dormitories, the computer room, and the library.

libs.name: 泥潭二
libs.english_description: A wuxia mudlib built on the ES2/Annihilator engine lineage, part of the broader 'Mire' (nitan/NT) family but with its own independently written attribute-storage code — it doesn't share the nt6/nt1 branch's architecture bugs. At roughly 13,000 source files, it has its own version of the 'birth ceremony' registration ritual seen in nt6, right down to matching file names, an interesting case of convergent design within the same broader engine scene despite being coded independently.

libs.name: 泥潭II
libs.english_description: A sibling build in the same ES2/Annihilator-engine family as nte (Mire 2), sharing several core infrastructure files byte-for-byte with it — the login, naming, and version-sync daemons — while the roughly 10,000 remaining files of actual game content were developed independently. Like nte, it gates full 'born' status behind a creation-myth NPC dialogue ritual rather than a simple registration step.

libs.name: 世纪
libs.english_description: A member of the "Warring States" codebase family (an adm/obj/master.lpc branch) — despite a slug resembling sje/sjecl (the "Book and Sword" series) elsewhere in this archive, it's an entirely unrelated lineage from those Century/adm-single titles. Its setting is science-fiction interstellar war rather than traditional wuxia: new characters start in the Tianlang star sector, buy starships at the spaceport, and align with one of four rival factions, with even wizard rank displayed under the in-universe title "Galaxy Special Police."

libs.name: 书剑贰
libs.english_description: A Hubei Telecom "Book and Sword II" MUD, version 2.1, belonging to the same Century/adm-single engine family (adm/single/master.lpc plus adm/daemons/securityd.lpc) as sjecl (The Book and the Sword) elsewhere in this archive.

libs.name: 书剑恩仇录
libs.english_description: A Chongqing Telecom "Book and Sword" MUD based on Jin Yong's novel of the same name (published in English as The Book and the Sword), part of the Century/adm-single engine family (adm/single/master.lpc plus adm/daemons/securityd.lpc) shared with sje, sjplgfjxb, and sjplii elsewhere in this archive.

libs.name: 书剑飘零官方教学版
libs.english_name: Stray Book and Sword: Official Tutorial Edition
libs.english_description: The official tutorial edition of Feibai Studio's Stray Book and Sword, built on the ES II engine family (adm/obj/master.lpc, "original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator") and sharing its codebase with sibling title sjplii (Stray Book and Sword II). Despite also carrying the words "Book and Sword," it belongs to an entirely different engine lineage from the Century/adm-single family's sjecl and sje — a naming coincidence, nothing more.

libs.name: 书剑飘零II
libs.english_description: Another Feibai Studio "Stray Book and Sword" title on the ES II engine, sibling to sjplgfjxb (the Official Tutorial Edition), but using a single, unambiguous adm/daemons/securityd.lpc rather than its sibling's confusing dual securd/securityd setup.

libs.archive: 三界神话（宝鸡站的版本）.rar
libs.name: 三界神话
libs.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Baoji Station)
libs.english_description: The original Baoji-station build of the "Myth of the Three Realms" (San Jie Shen Hua) series — the first of five related codebases in this archive, the other four being sjshv150, sjshv2578bb, sjshwzb, and sjshwzjqb.

libs.name: 三界神话V1.50
libs.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Wisteria Branch)
libs.english_description: The second build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, the Baoji-station original) — content for the Wisteria branch server, which differs somewhat from the Baoji station but shares the same core codebase. Kaifeng city is a substantial standalone puzzle-quest zone later reused by the "Chutian" server, and the game's own included notes candidly admit it "still has bugs galore, including one known (minor) backdoor."

libs.name: 三界神话v2.578b版
libs.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Test Zone 2)
libs.english_description: The third build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, the Baoji-station original, and sjshv150, the Wisteria branch) — content for a "Test Zone 2" server. Unlike its Wisteria-branch sibling, this build's site daemon allows local loopback connections unconditionally, giving it a smoother out-of-the-box registration experience.

libs.name: 三界神话完整版
libs.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms: Complete Edition (Quanzhou)
libs.english_description: The fourth build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, sjshv150, and sjshv2578bb) — the complete edition run by the Quanzhou Normal College site. Unlike its three siblings, its core system files (master.lpc, securityd.lpc, logind.lpc) represent a genuine code fork rather than a mere content variant, and it's the most content-rich entry in the family, with exclusive areas drawing on Buddhist and mythological concepts such as Asura, the Demon Realm, and the Sky Realm.

libs.name: 三界神话完整加强版
libs.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms: Enhanced Complete Edition (Quanzhou)
libs.english_description: The fifth and final build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, sjshv150, sjshv2578bb, and sjshwzb) — an enhanced edition sharing sjshwzb's Quanzhou map and core system files almost exactly, differing mainly in operational details such as starting with an empty wizard list rather than a pre-seeded one.

libs.name: 天涯&碧血江湖
libs.english_name: Bi Xue Jiang Hu — Tianya Edition
libs.english_description: The Tianya MUD Wizard Group's "Bi Xue Jiang Hu" (Jianghu of Sworn Blood) archive, a long-running wuxia MUD that has operated since 2002. The archive compiled and booted cleanly under WASM with no fixes needed, but deeper functional testing turned up several real, previously unknown bugs, including a serious security flaw dating back to the game's founding. It belongs to the same "Tianya" codebase family as several other archives in this collection (including wlhd and xhcii), sharing near-identical core systems even where each site's map content was customized independently.

libs.name: 武林浩荡
libs.english_name: Wu Lin Hao Dang (Jin Yong's Dream II)
libs.english_description: Branded in-game as Jin Yong's Dream II / Wu Lin Hao Dang, this archive shares an evidently common codebase with this collection's tybxjh (Bi Xue Jiang Hu) — its master, security, and login daemons are nearly identical — and belongs to the same "Tianya" code family as several other archives here (xhcii, zxty, ffxymud, jhfy2, and others). It even rewrote one shared scene, the "Peak of the World" cliff-jump, with its own custom "jump" command — a variant later reused verbatim by this collection's yxjh.

libs.name: 无情风云
libs.english_name: Wu Qing Feng Yun (Invincible Under Heaven)
libs.english_description: The Zhengzhou Fengyun "Collector's Edition," branded in-game as "Invincible Under Heaven," is a wuxia MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels rather than the more common Jin Yong universe, with sect and faction names to match. It required no fixes at all to run cleanly under WASM. It shares an identical codebase with this collection's zzfy3 (Zhengzhou Fengyun 3) — a relationship not previously documented between the two archives.

libs.name: 西安交大西游记
libs.english_name: Xi'an Jiaotong University Journey to the West (Huanle Yuan)
libs.english_description: Version 4.50 of "Mythical World: Journey to the West," branded in-game as Huanle Yuan ("Garden of Joy," subtitled "A Journey to the West, College Edition") — a MUD affiliated with the Terracotta Warriors BBS at Xi'an Jiaotong University.

libs.name: 笑傲江湖4公开版
libs.english_name: Xiao Ao Jiang Hu IV — Public Edition (Sunset Reappears)
libs.english_description: Branded in-game as "Sunset Reappears: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer IV," this is the fourth-generation version author Afei built atop the "Yanlong" engine core. It required no fixes to run cleanly under WASM. It shares byte-identical scenes with this collection's jhfy3 and xyzx, both also carrying the "Sunset Reappears" brand, making it a genuine member of that lineage — unlike another group of archives that use the same brand name but actually descend from the unrelated "Tianya" codebase.

libs.name: 笑红尘Ⅱ
libs.english_name: Xiao Hong Chen II (Laughing at the Red Dust II)
libs.english_description: Developed by Topkan Information Group (topkan.com), Xiao Hong Chen II shares its map — sects and cities including Huashan, Wudang, Emei, the Beggars' Sect, Dali, and Jingzhou — and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene almost verbatim with this collection's tybxjh and wlhd, marking it as another branch of the same "Tianya" code family. WASM testing initially judged the archive fully working, but deeper functional testing later corrected that assessment and uncovered real, previously undocumented bugs.

libs.name: 侠客行一百
libs.english_description: By Coollizard & xkx100, 2003-2004, hosted at yoyo.xm.fj.cn/xkx100 — a completely different codebase from the separately built GitHub fluffos/xkx100 repository that merely happens to share the same name. Its map is among the largest of its kind, stretching from central-China cities like Chang'an, Luoyang, Dali, and Xiangyang out to frontier and overseas settings such as the northern steppes, Kazakhstan, and Taiwan, covering nearly the full geography of ancient China. Character creation is unusually detailed for the genre, letting players choose a birthplace from five options, freely allocate attribute points, and pick from a menu of personality traits.

libs.name: 侠客行2000最新版
libs.english_description: The Quest of Oriental Chivalry ("Xiake Xing I"), by the XiaKeXing Gaming Group, 1996-1999, MudOS v22b25 lineage, ported by sdong. Shares the same map skeleton as this project's jym (Jin Yong's Dream) — scenes such as d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc are identical in content, differing only in the "cracker" credit header ("Cracked by Kafei" here versus "Cracked by Roath" for jym/xkm) — evidently different circulating copies of the same underlying codebase. Its map covers classic sect landmarks like Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Murong clan, and Zhongnan, plus geographic settings such as Dongting Lake, Lake Tai, Huangshan, and the Western Xia region; registration opens with a GB/BIG5 encoding choice, typical of these older cross-strait shared designs.

libs.name: 侠客行2017
libs.english_description: The Story of Hero, MudOS v21 lineage — part of the same core codebase family as this project's xkx100 and xkx2000zxb, visible at a glance in the structure of combatd.lpc and quest.h. It shares that core codebase but with a noticeably more compact map: the major sects (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Ming Cult, and more) are all present, but it lacks xkx100's frontier settings like the northern steppes, Kazakhstan, or Taiwan, reading more like a streamlined remake. Unlike its sibling xkx2000zxb, admin privileges here use the standard wizlist text-file mechanism with no site-IP lock, making it simpler to set up.

libs.name: 侠客新传98书剑
libs.english_name: New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman: '98 Edition
libs.english_description: "New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman" v0.1b, MudOS v22pre11, by the Xkxz MUD Wizard Group, 2000-2001, maintained by jjgod. Despite carrying "Book and Sword" in its Chinese title, it shares no lineage with this project's actual Book and Sword series (sjecl/sje/sjplgfjxb/sjplii) — the resemblance is purely coincidental naming, likely a site version codename from that year. It is also unrelated to the other "XKX"/Xiake-titled MUDs (xkx100/xkx2017) despite the similar name; a byte-for-byte comparison of master.lpc instead places it in the "hell / Doing Lu" lineage (ES II to XKX to hell), sharing ancestry with zjdyaryl, zjdyzj, and hell. Its map notably includes a Miao borderlands region with Gu-sorcery culture and sect settings, a relatively uncommon backdrop among these archives.

libs.name: 侠客行一百
libs.english_description: A branch from the "Xiamen Hotline 100" site, MudOS V22pre11. Despite sharing a title with this project's xkx100 (also "Ode to Gallantry 100"), this is a genuinely different, smaller snapshot (6,456 vs. 14,255 .lpc files, with a different directory layout including ftp/mudos.etc/www directories absent from xkx100), not a duplicate archive. Its map and sect roster lean closer to a "standard" configuration — Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Ming Cult, and the cities around Chang'an — more compact than xkx100's sprawling cross-border map. Comments in its bundled HTTP daemon note it was "modified to the ES2 mudlib base by xiaobao@XAJH," and another file marks its version as "MudOS v22.1b20, XAJH mudlib 2.0b," pointing to an earlier codebase branch known as "XAJH mudlib" rather than a direct descendant of xkx100's core code.

libs.name: 侠客英雄传III
libs.english_name: Legend of the Chivalrous Hero II/III (Happy Land)
libs.english_description: Legend of the Chivalrous Hero II/III, subtitled "Happy Land" and also styled "Wuyi: Boundless Heroism," set in a world blending Jin Yong's wuxia novels with European medieval legend and comic-book elements.

libs.name: 心声风云四升级版
libs.english_name: Voice of the Heart: Wind and Cloud IV, Upgraded Edition
libs.english_description: Wind and Cloud IV ("Fengyun," by Sumxin), a MUD set in the world of Gu Long's wuxia novels, originally hosted at sumxin.com/bbs and fy.sumxin.com. It is a true source sibling of this archive's "Fengyun IV Decrypted Edition" (fysjmb) — several core files are byte-for-byte identical — a relationship not previously documented, though it happens to share a similar bug pattern with the unrelated codebase behind this collection's "wqfy."

libs.name: 小雪初晴
libs.english_description: Branded in-game as "SnowMud," set in the world of Wen Ruian's wuxia novels. Developed by CuteRabbit Studio (JackyBoy) for the CCTX and SDXL communities.

libs.name: 小雪初晴II
libs.english_description: The sequel to "First Snow Clearing" (SnowMud), also set in the world of Wen Ruian's wuxia novels. A sibling archive to this collection's xxcq ("Legend of the Great Hero: First Snow Clearing").

libs.name: 西游记2000
libs.english_description: Journey to the West, also known as "Journey to the West: New Era," a venerable old-school MudOS mudlib set in the world of Wu Cheng'en's classic novel. Its registration flow includes an age-declaration prompt stating it "does not welcome primary/secondary school players" — an original design choice, not a bug.

libs.name: 西游记2003-2
libs.english_description: Archived under the name "Journey to the West 2003-2," but the game itself identifies at login as "Three Realms Myth," Test Zone 2 — the same codebase family as this archive's sjcs and sanjieshenhua (core functions such as get_gender(), enter_world(), and make_body() are byte-for-byte identical to sanjieshenhua). Its boot banner still carries leftover ASCII art from "Journey to the West: New Era," apparently a remnant of an earlier rebrand.

libs.name: 西游记2006年
libs.english_name: Journey to the West 2006 (AKAI Studio / Tomud)
libs.english_description: AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded release of Journey to the West, part of the Journey to the West series / ES II engine family. Its map is byte-identical to this archive's "Grand Tang Journey to the West: Complete Fixed Edition" (dtxywzxzb) — scene files such as d/gao/gate.lpc match exactly — suggesting both are different releases of the same underlying codebase, a relationship neither archive had previously documented. Its sibling release, "Journey to the West 2006: Final Fantasy" (xyj2006zzzhx), comes from the same distribution batch. Note for players: on connecting, the first line is not the usual charset-selection prompt but a bare "version" prompt expecting the literal client reply "2060" (an automatic response from Tomud/Smiling Proud Wanderer clients) — an intentional client-detection gate, not a bug.

libs.name: 西游记2006之最终幻想
libs.english_name: Journey to the West 2006: Final Fantasy (AKAI Studio / Tomud)
libs.english_description: Another branch of AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded Journey to the West line, sibling to this archive's xyj2006n (identical file structure and bugs). It uses the same connection handshake: the very first line sent must be the bare literal "2060" (the automatic reply from Tomud/Smiling Proud Wanderer clients), or the connection is treated as an illegal client and dropped.

libs.name: 西游记451
libs.english_description: Journey to the West, part of the ES II mudlib family (version 4.50). Its registration flow has no explicit "new character" keyword — entering an English ID that isn't already on file goes straight to "Creating a new character named X — are you sure? (y/n)". Talent points aren't allocated by adjusting slots but through a reroll loop: "Do you accept these talent values? [n|y|q]" — n rerolls, y accepts, and q presumably abandons character creation.

libs.name: 夕阳三-炎龙美化版
libs.english_name: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon (Fire Dragon Edition)
libs.english_description: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon, produced by AKAI Studio, uses the old Tomud/"Laughing in the Wind" client handshake protocol, where the first line after connecting must be answered with the literal code 2060. Despite its "Sunset Reappears" branding, its map data is byte-for-byte identical to the unrelated "Tianya" (Edge of Heaven) family of games rather than to the true Sunset Reappears lineage, one of several archives in this collection where the title brand and the actual code lineage don't match.

libs.name: 小雨西游utf8
libs.english_name: Light Rain Journey to the West (UTF-8 Snapshot)
libs.english_description: Another independent archive of the Xiaoyu Xiyou / Xiaoyu Xiyou II engine, its filename flagging that it had already been pre-converted to UTF-8. Though it shares an engine family with this project's xyxy2 and xiaoyuxiyou snapshots, a content-hash comparison shows it is not a byte-for-byte duplicate (8,753 vs. 11,149 .lpc files) — it's a snapshot from a different point in time, not just a re-encoding, so it was processed as its own distinct archive. Its map includes Aolai Country, the actual birthplace of Sun Wukong in the original novel, giving it geography closer to the source text than most other games in this family.

libs.name: 夕阳再现
libs.english_name: Sunset Reappears: Storm Rises Again II
libs.english_description: This is the "Storm Rises Again II" branch of Sunset Reappears. Its login and registration flow closely resembles sibling archives xysylmhb and xyzxiiylzymh, but its map data is the genuine Sunset Reappears lineage — byte-identical to jhfy3 and xajh4gkb — whereas those two similarly-branded siblings actually run on an unrelated "Tianya" map family, the same "shared core, swapped map" pattern seen elsewhere in this collection. Unlike its siblings, this build doesn't require the old Tomud client handshake on its standard port.

libs.archive: 夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端.rar
libs.name: 夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端
libs.english_name: Sunset Reappears II: Fire Dragon Client Edition
libs.english_description: Another build of Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon by AKAI Studio, in the same family as xysylmhb (Sunset III: Fire Dragon Edition), and likewise using the old Tomud client handshake protocol. As with xysylmhb, its map actually belongs to the unrelated "Tianya" family rather than the true Sunset Reappears lineage — another case in this collection where the title's branding doesn't match the underlying code's true origin.

libs.name: 夕阳再现-炎龙20141231
libs.english_name: Sunset Reappears: Fire Dragon Edition (2014-12-31 Build)
libs.english_description: A more heavily modified, later-stage build within the Sunset Reappears family: its custom wizard rank ladder runs all the way up to "(boss)"/"(ceo)", character creation adds an extra step for choosing one of eleven schools of magic after stat allocation, and it supports multiple client protocols (ZMud/ToMud).

libs.name: 炎黄武魂public-final-2016-12-08
libs.english_name: Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang (Public Final, 2016-12-08 Build)
libs.english_description: Another branch of the "Doing" engine lineage — the master.lpc file header traces its history explicitly: "for ES II mudlib... updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K), modified by Linux@lxtx for yh 2003.3." In-game the title reads "Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang." Registration splits surname and given name into separate prompts and requires both an admin password and a login password; character creation replaces the usual random-stat menu with a five-way archetype choice (Warrior/Sage/Endurance/Agility/Balanced) and skips the email step entirely.

libs.name: 浴血江湖
libs.english_name: Blood-Soaked Jianghu III: Return to the Jianghu
libs.english_description: Blood-Soaked Jianghu III: Return to the Jianghu, published by KMMUD.COM. Registration runs through an English ID, then a full Chinese name entered as a single string (no separate surname/given-name split), a dual-password system (admin password plus login password), a talent menu (0 for a random full set, y to accept), email, and gender. Its map and code closely track the 'Tianya' family's wlhd (Wulin Haodang / Jin Yong's Dream II) — its signature cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to wlhd's independently rewritten version — suggesting this archive evolved from, or alongside, wlhd, a lineage relationship no earlier archive in this collection had documented.

libs.name: 逸侠世界
libs.english_description: Daniel's World (逸俠之世界), part of the ES II engine family, produced in Taiwan (BBS 140.127.179.161; contact leonguo@tpts4.seed.net.tw). Registration runs through an English ID, Chinese name, password with confirmation, email, and gender.

libs.name: 游侠笑传II
libs.english_name: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II
libs.english_description: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II. Supports dual-encoding clients — after connecting, players choose GB or BIG5 encoding, and the BIG5 prompt line deliberately appears garbled when viewed under GBK, an intentional design touch rather than an encoding bug. Registration runs through encoding choice, English ID, Chinese name, password with confirmation, talent selection (y to accept), email, and gender.

libs.archive: 逸  俠  之  世  界.rar
libs.name: 逸  俠  之  世  界
libs.english_description: Daniel's World, the same ES II-family game as this collection's yxsj but a distinct build from a different point in the codebase's history — same title, same Taiwan contact email, same bug fingerprints, and the same file structure, yet not a byte-identical repackaging (its combatd.lpc, for instance, differs by roughly 80 lines) — worth keeping as a separate entry rather than treating as a duplicate.

libs.name: 阳再线III之炎龙封印
libs.english_name: Sunset Reborn III: Seal of the Flame Dragon
libs.english_description: Sunset Reborn III: Seal of the Flame Dragon, produced by AKAI Studio in 2006. Like the other 'Sunset Reborn'-titled archives in this collection, it uses the Tomud '2060' client handshake, rejecting any first input that isn't literally the string '2060' before asking for an English ID. Despite the 'Sunset Reborn' title, its map actually belongs to the unrelated 'Tianya' lineage (its signature cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to xysylmhb/xyzxiiylzymh), not the true 'Sunset Reborn' family (xyzx/jhfy3/xajh4gkb/xyzxyl201412) — the tenth confirmed 'Tianya' family member found in this collection.

libs.name: 终极地狱2008完整版
libs.english_description: Ultimate Hell 2008: Complete Edition ('Revive of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic)', originally from 1999.11.13, produced by CDS). Part of the same 'Doing'-lineage 'Hell' family as this collection's hell archive — its master.lpc, logind.lpc, named.lpc, and versiond.lpc are structured almost line-for-line the same.

libs.name: 终极地狱完整版
libs.english_description: Ultimate Hell: Complete Edition (in-game banner: 'Emperor of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic), from 2002.06.2'). Part of the same 'Doing'-lineage 'Hell' family as this collection's zjdy2008wzb — its master.lpc, logind.lpc, and named.lpc are structured almost line-for-line the same (the original archive was itself named hell).

libs.name: 再现天涯
libs.english_description: Tianya Reborn (in-game banner: 'Dream Return to Tianya'). Unrelated to the Doing-lineage 'Hell' family covered elsewhere in this collection, but shares the same source code as the 'Tianya' family (tybxjh/wlhd/xhcii) — its 'Peak of the World' cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to theirs, a lineage relationship none of those four archives had previously documented about each other.

libs.name: 再现天涯（08年修改版本）
libs.english_description: The 2008 revised re-release of the same 'Tianya Reborn' game as this collection's zxty — the master.lpc content differs with no exact hash match, but it shares the same title and origin. Its quit command has a genuine anti-abuse mechanism: a new account logged in for under 30 minutes must press quit twice to actually exit without saving, a deliberate design choice rather than a bug.

libs.name: 郑州风云3
libs.english_description: Zhengzhou Storm 3 (in-game banner: 'Fengyun Series: Invincible Under Heaven'), a Gu Long-style wuxia MUD founded by Xgchen ('Elder Sun Wuqing'). Shares the same 'Zhengzhou Storm' map and codebase as this collection's wqfy ('Heartless Storm', which carries the same 'Invincible Under Heaven' banner) — a relationship neither archive's documentation had previously noted. It also turns out to be a near-duplicate of this collection's other 'Zhengzhou Storm 3' archive (zzfy): same engine and map, over 10,000 files nearly all identical, differing in fewer than 200 — the two are kept as separate entries rather than merged.

libs.name: 武学大道
libs.english_name: Wu Xue Da Dao (The Great Way of Martial Arts)
libs.english_description: A wuxia MUD that begins in the "Peach Blossom Spring," a legendary hidden utopia, built around a non-standard mobile-client protocol rather than plain-text telnet prompts. New characters must complete an elaborate, multi-step "rebirth" ritual — allocating attribute points, rerolling aptitudes, choosing a temperament, and picking one of seven ancestral clans — before they truly enter the world.

libs.name: 泥潭6
libs.english_description: A large NT/nitan ('Mire') lineage wuxia mudlib built on a creation myth — Pangu splitting heaven and earth, yin and yang emerging from chaos — and spanning over 23,000 source files, making it one of the largest games in this collection. Its signature touch is a 'birth ceremony': after registering, a new character isn't considered fully 'born' until they travel to the Registration realm and complete a ritual dialogue with mythic NPCs like Pangu and Ksitigarbha, weaving the tutorial gate directly into the game's own mythology rather than just an email-confirmation step.

libs.name: 泥潭6 (win_nodb版)
libs.english_description: A same-lineage variant of nt6 (Mire 6), packaged as a database-free 'win_nodb' build — every file touched by this project's fixes was byte-for-byte identical to nt6's pre-fix version. It shares nt6's sprawling map, stretching from the central Chinese heartland cities of Chang'an and Luoyang out to Annam (Vietnam), Korea, Kazakhstan, and Taiwan, plus its own dedicated 'reborn' area layered onto the same registration-room mechanic.

libs.name: 妖神之争
libs.english_description: A wuxia/xianxia MUD set in the mythological world of Journey to the West. New characters enter through the framework of the pilgrimage to the West, starting out at the South City Inn in Chang'an.

libs.archive: 南京河海大学的es2和xkx《校内_1.01版》.tar.gz
libs.name: es2/侠客行（南京河海大学校内版1.01）
libs.english_name: Eastern Story II x Xiake Xing (Hohai University Campus Edition)
libs.english_description: A hybrid of the ES2 and Xiake Xing ('The Wandering Knight') engine lineages, built as a computer-science-department test build at Hohai University in Nanjing. The content is still a work in progress, but the world already has personality — the pawnshop owner in Snow Pavilion Town is secretly a hidden master far stronger than any other early-game NPC, while the doorkeeper at the Chunfeng martial arts hall only fights seriously against his own sect's disciples, pulling his punches against everyone else.

libs.name: 海洋（基础版）
libs.english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Jin Yong's novels (though players are asked not to reuse character names from the novels themselves). Its community calls itself the “Alliance of Loyalty and Righteousness” (Qingyimeng).

libs.name: 海洋5
libs.english_description: Another branch of the “Ocean” code line — related to hy in this project but heavily diverged in content (line counts differ substantially, so fixes cannot be assumed to sit at matching locations). It's a wuxia-themed world whose community calls itself “Ocean V.” Its adm/obj/master.lpc is byte-identical to hy's, but its security daemon (adm/daemons/securd.lpc) has been independently rewritten — the two share a common source root, but their security models diverge considerably in implementation.

libs.name: 金庸梦
libs.english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Jin Yong's novels. Its map directory structure heavily overlaps with this project's xkx2000zxb (Ode to Gallantry 2000, Latest Edition, MudOS v22b25 lineage) — scenes such as the ancestral hall at the Lake Tai ancient tomb are identical, differing only in the "cracked by" credit in the file headers ("Cracked by Kafei" there versus "Cracked by Roath" here) — indicating both are different circulating copies of the same underlying "Ode to Gallantry I" codebase, a relationship neither archive had previously recorded. xkm (Ode to Gallantry's Dream) and bmxkx2001 (Ode to Gallantry, North America 2001 Edition) are sibling archives from the same "Cracked by Roath" release line.

libs.name: 泥潭1
libs.english_description: An independent branch of the NT/nitan ('Mire') engine family — deep testing found no exact code match to sibling games nitan170911, nitan6, or hhsj, confirming it grew up on its own. New characters must first pass through a 'registration room' and use a built-in register-with-email command before their attributes are even assigned, an extra gate reminiscent of the 'reincarnation' step found in the Hell/Doing family of games. Character creation also layers a temperament type and a character-class type on top of the usual gender choice.

libs.name: 武动仙途
libs.english_name: Wu Dong Xian Tu (Martial Path to Immortality)
libs.english_description: A large, 46,890-file archive whose conversion originally timed out mid-transfer. It uses a custom client protocol rather than a plain-text telnet prompt: on connecting, the server issues a version challenge that the client must answer with a correctly encrypted response (or one of two built-in bypass strings), or be disconnected as an "illegal client." Account registration and character creation likewise arrive as single lines with multiple fields separated by a full-width vertical bar (║) — a design built for the game's dedicated GUI client, not a bug.

libs.name: 侠客梦
libs.english_description: Shares a code lineage (the same set of simul_efuns) with this project's jym (Jin Yong's Dream), though its registration flow branches differently, so the two should not be assumed to share an identical connection sequence. It also shares the same "Xiake Xing I" map skeleton (Taihu Ancient Tomb, Kunlun, Shaolin, and more) with xkx2000zxb, making all three different circulating versions drawn from the same underlying codebase.

libs.name: 风起云涌2
libs.english_description: Part of the same "Ocean" codebase lineage as several sibling archives in this project, sharing their distinctive hardcoded backdoor admin mechanism. Features a larger-than-usual map including the classic sects alongside an independent Assassins' Tower faction and a marriage system, blending social and underworld gameplay. Its admin roster is stored not in a plain text file but inside the security daemon's own save data.

libs.name: 风云II（美国版本）
libs.english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels. It belongs to the “Jinyong Qunxiazhuan”/XKX framework family and shares the same adm/obj/master.lpc with sibling games jyqxc, jyqxc2, jyqxc2013fwq, and xkx2017 — but its game content is entirely different, so it is catalogued here under its own number.

libs.name: 风云III (3.0)
libs.english_description: Like fy2mg, this belongs to the “Jinyong Qunxiazhuan”/XKX framework family — the login flow, check_legal_name, password complexity rules, and ethnicity selection are byte-for-byte identical — but its game content and title are different, and its master file hash does not match any of the other “Storm”-branded games in this collection (fy2, fys, fysjmb, jhfy2, jhfy3, fyzfqyy, fy2qh, fy3dz, fy3xd, jhfy, zzfy, zzfy3, fengyun434, fy2005).

libs.name: 雄霸天下III
libs.english_name: Xiong Ba Tian Xia III (Lord of the World III)
libs.english_description: A genuine 1997-2001-era mudlib by its own internal readme, descended from the "Fengyun" lineage. The original archive shipped as four split zip volumes containing twelve directory-by-directory tar.gz files rather than a flat directory tree. Character creation blends Western MUD-style classes (a choice between enchanter and fighter) with a wuxia setting, and death leads into an unusually elaborate five-stage ghost journey narrated by the deity Bai Wuchang.

libs.archive: 侠客行老版(金庸群侠传）.rar
libs.name: 侠客行（老版/金庸群侠传）
libs.english_name: Ode to Gallantry (Old Edition / Heroes of Jin Yong)
libs.english_description: Extracted from a mislabeled ".rar" that is actually a POSIX tar archive with "../"-prefixed member paths. The archive also contains an unused adm/obj/master.lpc that happens to share identical bytes with the jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 framework code, but the site actually boots from a different file, /adm/single/master, so this look-alike master was never really loaded. Its map resembles the jyqxc/jyqxc2 family (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, and more).

libs.name: 西游记 4.2
libs.english_description: A MUD set in the world of Journey to the West.

libs.name: 西游记4.2 (dup)
libs.group_note: line-ending-only duplicate of 156 (xyj42, archive 西游记4.2.gz) -- identical file tree, every file differs only by CRLF vs LF; processed once

libs.archive: 最新独立安卓客户端和书剑源码一键架站.zip
libs.name: 书剑3
libs.english_description: Extracted from a nested archive that also bundled an Android client APK alongside this source tree. Despite the shared "Book and Sword" branding, it shares no code lineage with bxsj/bxsj1 or any other library in this collection — an entirely independent codebase, richer than a simple sect-and-map layout thanks to instanced dungeon content plus dedicated music and guild areas.

libs.name: 指尖MUD
libs.english_description: Extracted from a nested archive (zjmud.7z, containing a folder named 'hell'). Its core system files (master.lpc, logind.lpc, and others) were heavily rewritten to support a custom mobile-phone client protocol, but its map content is byte-for-byte identical to this collection's 'Hell'/Doing engine family (hell/zjdy2008wzb/zjdywzb) — the entire sect-and-city world was ported onto an independently developed mobile client engine rather than being a simple in-engine derivative. It shares the same mobile-app protocol and custom logind.lpc lineage as shujian3, though the two differ in how strictly they enforce their registration handshake.

libs.name: DeadSouls-FluffOS2019
libs.english_description: The fluffos GitHub org's own maintained fork of the classic Dead Souls 3.8.6 LPC mudlib library/tutorial, pre-adapted for modern FluffOS (targets the v2019 driver branch as a git submodule) rather than a legacy archive dump -- a separate, independently-sourced snapshot from this collection's other Dead Souls entry (ds386, converted from an unrelated standalone legacy archive), kept as a distinct slug per this project's convention for meaningfully different sources of the same underlying codebase.

libs.archive: git clone https://github.com/fluffos/nightmare3 (not a traditional archive file — a maintained, already FluffOS-adapted fork; mudlib root is the repo's lib/ directory)
libs.name: Nightmare 3
libs.english_description: One of the oldest and most historically influential LPMud mudlib families, an ancestor of the TMI-2 lineage. This fork (fluffos/nightmare3) is already updated for modern FluffOS. New characters pick a race in a genesis void room before rolling stats and entering Praxis, the mudlib's own shipped example domain built around a central town square. Unlike the rest of this collection, content is in English, included deliberately for its historical importance to the wider LPMud family tree.

libs.name: IMUD@FluffOS.v2019
libs.english_description: The FluffOS project's own tiny live demo at imud.fluffos.info, not a game: connecting drops you straight into an anonymous session (no login, no registration, no player object/save data, no rooms) with exactly two commands, mudlist (lists the real, live Intermud-3 network via a genuine outbound socket connection to the *i4 router) and update (reload an object by path). Included as a preserved reference example of a minimal from-scratch FluffOS mudlib/I3-client rather than a wuxia game.

libs.name: 三国志
libs.english_description: A Three-Kingdoms-themed Chinese MUD built on the Lima mudlib base (TMI-2/Ellery security lineage), already partially adapted by this project's own maintainer for a modern FluffOS driver before being folded into this collection. Players start from a Lima-style wizard hall, roll a talent template (valor/strategy/charisma archetypes), and build a career across a real map of Three-Kingdoms-era cities, garrisons and nations -- recruiting personal troops, riding named historical horses, and taking government office.

libs.archive: git clone https://github.com/fluffos/nt7 (王者归来, "泥潭7" — already a UTF-8/FluffOS-v2019-adapted community fork, not a raw legacy archive)
libs.name: 王者归来
libs.english_description: A member of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine family (see nitan170911, nitan6, hhsj, xfbhh, nt1, nt6) sourced from an already-git-hosted, community-maintained fork rather than a raw archive: the upstream repo had already been transcoded to UTF-8 and adapted for a modern FluffOS driver years before this pass. Core daemons (master.lpc, logind.lpc, securityd.lpc, chinesed.lpc) share the family's overall shape but have diverged substantially in content from every sibling checked (hundreds to thousands of differing lines even after whitespace normalization) -- a real independent branch, not a duplicate. New characters undergo the same Pangu creation-myth 'birth ceremony' as hhsj/nt6 (choose a personality, wash attributes in the Valley of Life, land in the Ancient Village), but nt7's own object-property-storage architecture (the family's classic set()/query() 'this_object() resolves to the wrong object inside a simul_efun' bug, AGENTS.md's own biggest historical bug class for this lineage) was already correctly implemented upstream using previous_object() -- confirmed NOT present here, unlike its unfixed state on nitan170911/nitan6/hhsj/xfbhh/nt6/nt6nitan6win/nt1 before this project's own fixes. Chinese-name detection likewise already uses a real Unicode \p{Han} regex rather than the family's classic GBK-byte-range hack.

libs.name: Lima
libs.english_description: The FluffOS project's own reference mudlib (limalib.dev) -- a notable independent, English-language, modern-design LPC framework, not derived from the classic Chinese-lineage LPMud codebases in this collection. Centralized natural-language command parser, capability-based security daemon, and a wizard-oriented Unix-like shell rather than the usual add_action/wizlist model. Onboarded per AGENTS.md 2.3 (already-git-hosted, already-FluffOS-targeted source).

libs.name: 东方故事Ⅱ
libs.english_description: One of the earliest Chinese-language LPC mudlibs -- GitHub's mudchina org describes it as "the progenitor of Chinese MUDs" (中文MUD鼻祖). A from-scratch LPMud-lineage codebase (credited to Annihilator@Eastern.Stories, 1994-1995, built on the Lil mudlib with TMI feature-mixin code) rather than a reskin of an existing engine -- this project's own recurring "ES2/TMI-2/Falcon family" terminology for dozens of later Chinese mudlibs traces back to this exact lineage. Players register with a real Chinese name, land at a mountain inn (饮风客栈), and explore a wuxia/xianxia world of domains (city gates and streets, snow-capped mountains, a temple, a bamboo canyon, a ghost/graveyard area) with guild-style skill training, a two-tier reputation system, and NPCs including a Journey-to-the-West crossover (孙悟空).

libs.name: Genesis
libs.english_description: The official mudlib of Genesis, one of the oldest and most influential LPMuds still running. This is the engine only (master, login, std/ base classes, command souls, board/mail/bank/donation/report subsystems, the full wizard toolset) -- per the repo's own README, it ships no /d/Genesis game-world domain at all (no rooms, no NPCs, no items, no race content). Porting it surfaced two especially wide-reaching FluffOS-compat bugs: add_action() with a bare function value (used at 151 of 158 call sites, including the soul-command dispatch entry point) compiles but is never matched against typed input on this driver, and this codebase's own CD-driver-style uid/euid simulation had setuid()/seteuid() silently corrupting every object's owner uid via an unresolvable placeholder string. A from-scratch character-creation bootstrap and a bare landing room were added since no domain ships to place new characters in.

libs.name: RealmsMUD core-lib
libs.english_description: The official mudlib of RealmsMUD, a modern MySQL-backed FluffOS/LDMud-dialect engine with a substantial shipped game world (guilds, areas, quests, research/crafting systems). Porting it surfaced an unusually deep chain of FluffOS-compat bugs that each masked the next: add_action()'s command_giver-at-call-time requirement silently no-op'd every player's command registration when it ran (as upstream intended) from create() before exec() attached the real connection; this driver's strsrch() 3rd argument is a direction flag, not a start offset, which corrupted a hand-built regreplace()/regexplode() shim's multi-match handling and produced malformed command regexes; this driver's legacy regexp() efun hard-caps at 10 capture groups, breaking dispatch for any command with several flag aliases (switched command matching to pcre_match()); and LDMud's save_value()/restore_value() (absent here) were a hard compile error in the item base class, breaking every item in the game until a from-scratch LPC-literal serializer/parser was written. A MySQL 8.0 instance (provisioned locally, not part of the shipped repo) backs the login/player-account persistence layer.

libs.name: Final Realms
libs.english_description: A classic, from-scratch English-language MudOS mudlib whose own history dates to 1998 -- the oldest-vintage lib onboarded into this collection so far. A full game mudlib rather than a bare engine: 12 playable races with a real per-race starting zone, guilds, shops, taverns, and a full wizard toolset. The most severe porting bug: this driver build lacks the newer ed_start()/ed_cmd()/query_ed_mode() editor efuns this codebase's player-object code was written against (only the older single-efun ed() is available) -- left unfixed, this would have broken compilation of the entire player object, blocking every connection. Rewritten against the real ed() efun. A second mud-wide bug -- secure/gods.lpc/lords.lpc never defined the functions secure/master.lpc calls to build its admin-permission list, silently breaking wizard-permission checks for every account except the archive's own pre-blessed 'god' character -- was also fixed.

libs.name: 泥潭三 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan3)
libs.english_description: A git-hosted snapshot of the same 'Nitan III' codebase already in this collection as nitan_san (archive-sourced) -- confirmed byte-identical across 15,235 of 15,236 shared files, including the master object. Branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm,' a skin over the shared NT/nitan/Lonely engine. New characters choose a name and personality and are delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life, matching the creation-myth path shared with nitan_san and nitan_ceshi. Needs no external database; registration and saves are local-file-based.
